name: Instruction Following

metrics.description: Share of cases where every constraint was met on the response exactly as returned.
The same share after a code fence, a conversational lead-in or surrounding quotes are stripped. Reported beside the strict figure, never in place of it.
Share of individual constraints met, so breaking one rule of five is distinguishable from breaking five.
Formatting violations per case: opening text, closing text, required pattern.
Length violations per case: word count, line count.
Keyword violations per case: a required phrase absent or a forbidden one present.
Structural violations per case: list length, per-line shape.
Language violations per case: the answer was not written in the requested script.

description: Deterministic constraint checking. Every case states machine-checkable constraints, the prompt shows the model exactly the constraints the scorer will apply, and no part of the score involves judgement about meaning.
